passage:
Dear Mom and Dad,
Camp is not as scary as I thought. On the first night, I wanted to go home because the room was dark and everyone was new. But my roommate, Tom, told funny stories until we fell asleep.
Today we climbed a small mountain. I was slow, but no one laughed. Our teacher said finishing was more important than being first. From the top, the lake looked like a mirror. I took many pictures.
Tomorrow we will cook dinner outside. I hope the rice will not burn.
Please do not worry about me. I still miss home, but I am beginning to understand why people like camp.
Love,
Kevin
